texts.label: text
texts.orig: After studying the position of the Arab tribes and the population who settled in the Levant on the Islamic conquest; the study found:
texts.text: After studying the position of the Arab tribes and the population who settled in the Levant on the Islamic conquest; the study found:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 1-The Arab tribes and other elements that stood by the fence were apprehensively waiting out of fear for who prevails.
texts.text: 1-The Arab tribes and other elements that stood by the fence were apprehensively waiting out of fear for who prevails.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 3-Jews welcomed Arab conquerors because of the poor relationship with the Roman Empire.
texts.text: 3-Jews welcomed Arab conquerors because of the poor relationship with the Roman Empire.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 2-The Arab tribes that converted to Christianity were not truly Christian and some of whom were forced to fight the Romans in the war. along
texts.text: 2-The Arab tribes that converted to Christianity were not truly Christian and some of whom were forced to fight the Romans in the war. along

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 4-Some cities of the Levant showed resistance to the Islamic conquest; and the most resistant were the northern and coastal ones.
